name: 79936 · El Paso, TX
findings: ZIP 79936 (El Paso) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (45% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79936 (El Paso) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 79936 (El Paso) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).
